atlas_label.Description: Anatomical label of the contact as given in the source localisation file ('label' column)

atlas_index.Description: 'index' column of the source dkt localisation file (atlas label index)

labels_sorted.Description: 'labels_sorted' column of the source: candidate labels around the contact, '|'-separated

percent_assigned.Description: 'percent_assigned' column of the source: fraction of the contact neighbourhood assigned to each label in labels_sorted, '|'-separated
